Hi Luke / team — thanks for your patience. We completed the reconciliation against the May 1 renewal window and confirmed the following: 

Summary:
- Raw usage (attached CSV) shows a spike on 2027-05-03 through 2027-05-06 where token consumption exceeded the newly committed pool after the renewal cut-over. The automated billing pipeline applied an overage true-up for the delta.
- Calculation: accumulated excess tokens for May 1–7 multiplied by Evergreens post-renewal overage rate = $18,400 (matches invoice line).

Resolution offered:
- Because Evergreen raised a rollout delay during the renewal conversation, and given this is a first-time post-renewal spike attributable to a short rollout window, Redwood will apply a one-time courtesy credit of $12,000 against INV-7721.
- We have created an amended invoice (amended-invoice-INV-7721.pdf) reflecting the $12,000 credit; outstanding balance becomes $6,400.
- If Evergreen would like committed capacity increased to avoid future overages, Sofia can draft SOW amendment; were prepared to price a temporary top-up at the same monthly committed rate for the remainder of Q3.

Next actions:
- Luke, please confirm acceptance of the amended invoice and whether youd like the SOW amendment.
- I will also post the reconciliation doc to the shared Drive link and update the HubSpot deal with the credit note.

Laura Bennett
